# Goutham Arelli

> Backend Engineer focused on scalable systems, reliability, and enterprise agentic payments.

This site is a portfolio for Goutham Arelli, a backend engineer based in Hyderabad, India. It is most relevant for backend engineering, platform engineering, distributed systems, payments SDKs, and agentic commerce roles.

## Site Sections

- Home: positioning, contact links, and resume download.
- Production Foundation: Pine Labs backend work around EMI systems, throughput, observability, and reliability.
- Pine Labs P3P: enterprise Payments Protocol SDKs (company product) — TypeScript/Python client and server libraries for x402 agentic payments.
- Experience Timeline: Eduspeed Technologies and Cognizant.
- Engineering direction: using LLM tools carefully while owning architecture.
- MCP Nexus: personal side-project research prototype (not company product).
- Stack, education, and contact.

## Key Signals

- 4+ years backend/full-stack engineering experience.
- 2000+ TPS EMI Offer Discovery capacity improvement.
- 50% backend-call reduction through caching and lazy loading.
- Enterprise P3P SDK ownership at Pine Labs for agentic payments.

## P3P (Company)

P3P is Pine Labs’ enterprise agentic payments protocol. Goutham’s role is SDK ownership and enterprise readiness across client and server SDKs (TypeScript and Python), including auth, capture flows, and Grantex spend controls.

Public packages:

- https://www.npmjs.com/package/p3p-client-sdk
- https://www.npmjs.com/package/p3p-server-sdk
- https://pypi.org/project/pinelabs-online-p3p-client-sdk/
- https://pypi.org/project/pinelabs-online-p3p-server-sdk/
- https://grantex.dev

## MCP Nexus (Personal)

MCP Nexus is a personal AI-assisted research prototype, not a production SaaS claim and not a Pine Labs product.
